title: Silas and the Hymn
author: Elodie Fairweather
blurb: Marguerite Halloran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
